note: Walker sprite mapping. Sprite refs use the atlas index of 'file' (extracted/sprites/<file>/atlas.json). Rules: docs/play/walkers.md.

convention.walk_index: start + frame*dirs + dir (frame-major); dir 0..7 = NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N = the original's direction code 0..7 (0 = tile y-1) with the camera unrotated
convention.frames: walk groups have 12 frames; anim_frame advances +1 every sim tick and wraps at 12 (not tied to movement)
convention.mirrors: the extracted PNGs of the mirrored directions (SW,W,NW) already exist and are already flipped; just use the PNG of the index (atlas mirror_of is informational)
convention.anchor: draw the image so that its (anchor_x, anchor_y) pixel sits on the walker position (tile diamond centre + sub-tile offset)
convention.shadow: pure red (255,0,0) pixels in the PNGs are the shadow mask; draw them as a translucent dark shadow (not verified in the exe blitter)
convention.die: die blocks are direction-less: frame = min(ticks since death, frames-1); the exe deletes the walker after 127 ticks
convention.shared_dir_less_blocks: blocks with dirs=1 are plain frame sequences (index = start + frame)

cart.orig: FIG_CART (type 4), also 9 storehouseman, 28 oxcart, 36 deliveryman (same pusher group 4729)
cart.draw: pusher sprite at the walker position + cart overlay at position + offsets[dir]; for dir S (3) the cart is drawn after (over) the pusher, for every other dir before (under). Heavy goods (heavy:true): handler walk 1337 at the walker position, trailer overlay at offsets[dir] (behind), ox (walk 209) between them (hypothesis: about half the trailer offset); draw order trailer, ox, handler except dirs SE,S,SW (2,3,4) where handler first. Level: units<=200 -> 0, <=400 -> 1, else 2 (clamped to levels-1); 1 load = 100 units, so sim carts are level 0.
